top_signals.title: Redwire is Growing Strawberries in Space
top_signals.summary: Redwire CEO Peter Cannito joins Bloomberg Open Interest to break down the next phase of the space economy—from orbital data centers and cheaper space manufacturing to the growing US, China space race. He also explains why falling transportation costs, SpaceX partnerships and even space agriculture could create major new commercial opportunities. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: The Coming Shakeout in Private Credit
top_signals.summary: Achilles Global Management CIO and Founder Sachin Khajuria says private credit is entering a decade-long shakeout as higher rates expose weaker managers and drive a flight to quality. He joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why private markets could emerge stronger and warns retail investors moving into private assets to closely examine liquidity, transparency and risk. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Senegal, IMF Reach Staff Agreement on $2.2 Billion Loan Program
top_signals.summary: Senegal and the International Monetary Fund reached a preliminary deal for a program that will resume lending to the West African nation, two years after funding was frozen following the discovery of billions of dollars of previously hidden loans.

top_signals.title: Wells Fargo, Barclays Backed Collapsed Headlam With £85 Million
top_signals.summary: Wells Fargo & Co. and Barclays Plc provided as much as £85 million ($115 million) to Headlam Group Plc just months before the British flooring distributor appointed insolvency officials.
